name: Kurgan
description: Kurgan was a legendary hero of the Sacred Vollachia Empire revered as the 'War God' and 'Eight Arms' of the Multi-Arm Tribe. Celebrated as the Empire's strongest warrior in life, he was resurrected as a corpse soldier by the Witch Cult during the siege of Priestella in Arc 5, engaging Garfiel Tinsel in a monumental duel.
